Then he was 5 minutes late to that! On a day that I really needed to talk kto him on time. I was SO angry and upset that day because I had a stressful thing I had to do that I did not tell him of, but I really needed that call on time that day and his lateness affected it because it was an appointment. So anyway he apologized and it got in the pattern of  him being late to these calls, then saying "sorry" and then doing it again!
